title: Proposed study collaboration on CBL-related disorder

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on CBL-related disorder
Dear RASopathies Network team, your network serves people with all RASopathies, including CBL-related disorder.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would welcome your thoughts on a study idea.
Published work links CBL-related disorder to loss of function of the CBL protein, but this is contested.
Gene2Phenotype classifies it as gain of function, and both views may describe the same variants at different levels.
A recruiting observational study covers children and adults with RASopathies.
Your contact registry and the Noonan Syndrome Foundation may also reach families, although neither names CBL directly, so that link is less certain.
We would propose [study aim and design], shaped with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your registry or community might take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If this interests you, could we arrange a short call at a convenient time?
Thank you for your time and for your work with families.
